0.reason: the landing record quotes the negative-control log's own summary line, 2 failed and 3 passed

1.reason: the landing record carries the importer figures from the manifest's suite objects: base 2 failed, 414 passed, 2 errors; after 2 failed, 416 passed

findings.text: follow-on: the recorded negative-control figure does not reconcile with the log it cites. docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-failed-catalogue-read-is-not-an-absent-catalogue.html:62 states '2 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1' and manifest.md:60 carries the same '2 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1', while logs/negative-control.log's own summary line reads '2 failed, 3 passed in 56.96s'. The failing ids and the exit code are right and the substance of the control is sound; the pass count is a misquote of the cited log, and a metric in the record should be that log's own summary line so the record reconciles with the log it cites.

follow-on: the gate table's two importer-suite rows defer their result as 'see below' and the figures are never given below. docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-failed-catalogue-read-is-not-an-absent-catalogue.html:60-61 read 'see below' for logs/after-importers.log and logs/base-importers.log, but the paragraph that follows states only where the logs live, so a reader of the fragment is pointed at a figure that is absent (the figures are recorded in the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite objects: base 2 failed / 414 passed / 2 errors, after 2 failed / 416 passed, no added failure).
